notes.title: BUG FIX
notes.notes:
Hello everyone.

We are excited to announce that Energy Survivors was launched yesterday, and we have already released the first patch to fix a couple of bugs.
[list]
[*] Fixed the bug where it was possible to apply the effect of injections multiple times.
[*] Fixed the bug by navigating between the main and options menus.
[/list]
We have many exciting ideas that we plan to implement in the game, and we would love to hear your feedback to make Energy Survivors an even more thrilling experience for everyone.

Stay tuned for further updates, as we have more exciting news to share soon.
